note: Fuzzer-controlled bytes are passed into the OTS parser and later influence table objects and serialized output.
A table can be marked passthrough, causing the parser to retain a direct pointer to the original input buffer instead of sanitizing it.
The passthrough table stores the input buffer pointer for later serialization.
The font object deletes table instances while passthrough tables still retain pointers into the original input buffer, violating lifetime safety for later use.
Serialization dereferences the retained input pointer after the owning font/table lifetime has ended, triggering heap-use-after-free in OTSStream::Write.
